article_title: Treadmills to deadlifts: Why Gen Z are swapping cardio for strength training

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why more young people are choosing strength-based, social exercise while cardio remains important
Why all UK gyms are removing treadmills and exercise bikes
Why strength training has been proven to replace every other form of exercise
Why young people are spending less money on health and fitness
tasks.correct_answer: Why more young people are choosing strength-based, social exercise while cardio remains important
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת את העלייה באימוני כוח ובפעילות חברתית בקרב צעירים, אך גם מדגישה שריצה ואירובי עדיין נפוצים.

tasks.prompt: How did Will Seward's workouts change over time?
options: He stopped exercising when he left secondary school.
He moved from running machines and bikes toward more explosive weight training.
He replaced gym workouts with only long-distance swimming.
He began training once a month instead of three times a week.
tasks.correct_answer: He moved from running machines and bikes toward more explosive weight training.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ויל התחיל בעיקר במכשירי ריצה ואופניים, ובהמשך עבר לאימוני משקולות מתפרצים כדי לפתח כוח ואתלטיות.

tasks.prompt: What does the question “Do numbers bear that out?” mean?
options: Can gym members lift those exact weights?
Are exercise costs written correctly?
Do the available statistics support that claim?
Do young people understand mathematical data?
tasks.correct_answer: Do the available statistics support that claim?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: bear that out פירושו לאשש או לתמוך בטענה. הכתבה שואלת האם הנתונים מאשרים את הרושם שיש יותר אימוני כוח.

tasks.prompt: Which benefit is linked in the article to doing the recommended strength training each week?
options: It guarantees professional athletic success.
It removes the need for any aerobic activity.
It prevents every case of osteoporosis.
It may lower cardiovascular risk while protecting the brain and boosting self-esteem.
tasks.correct_answer: It may lower cardiovascular risk while protecting the brain and boosting self-esteem.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר המתואר קושר כשעתיים של אימוני כוח להפחתת הסיכון למוות ממחלות לב או שבץ, להגנת המוח ולשיפור ההערכה העצמית.

tasks.prompt: What does Dr Al-Zubaidi mean by an “enormous ecosystem” for active people?
options: A wide network of gyms, clubs, apps, social media and wearable technology
A protected natural area used for outdoor exercise
A single government programme controlling all fitness activities
A medical system available only to professional athletes
tasks.correct_answer: A wide network of gyms, clubs, apps, social media and wearable technology
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ecosystem משמש כאן באופן מטפורי לרשת רחבה של שירותים, קהילות וטכנולוגיות שמקיפות ותומכות באנשים פעילים.

tasks.prompt: Why does Cordelia Sheridan describe her gym membership as an “essential utility bill”?
options: Her employer legally requires her to pay for a gym.
She treats the £45 monthly cost as a priority because exercise is central to her routine.
The gym provides electricity to her home.
She receives free meals whenever she pays the bill.
tasks.correct_answer: She treats the £45 monthly cost as a priority because exercise is central to her routine.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קורדליה רואה בדמי המנוי הוצאה חיונית וקבועה, בדומה לחשבון שירות, מפני שהאימון חשוב מאוד בשגרת חייה.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons mentioned in the article for the growing appeal of strength training.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי סיבות שונות שמופיעות בכתבה ולתמוך בכל אחת בפרט רלוונטי.
expected_points: It can improve body composition and shape relatively quickly.
People value becoming stronger, healthier and more athletic.
Strength training may provide health benefits for bones, the heart, brain and self-esteem.
Social media influencers make the activity visible and achievable.
Hybrid and group-based workouts are sociable, competitive and enjoyable.

tasks.prompt: Why might social connection be especially important in current exercise habits?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק מן הכתבה כיצד שינויים בחיי העבודה והקהילה הופכים פעילות חברתית למושכת, ולהביא פרט תומך.
expected_points: Working from home can reduce everyday contact, especially for young adults.
Nearby gyms, running clubs and community activities provide connection and routine.
People may keep exercising because an activity is enjoyable and sociable, not only because it prevents disease.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how exercise habits among younger adults are changing, according to the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את העלייה באימוני כוח, את תפקיד החברה או הרשתות, את מקומה המתמשך של הריצה ופרט אחד על עלויות או סדרי עדיפויות.
expected_points: More young adults are using gyms, machines and weights than nine years ago.
Strength and hybrid training appeal because of visible progress, health benefits and social connection.
Running remains highly popular, especially through organised events such as parkrun.
Many young adults treat fitness spending as a high priority despite tight budgets.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, evaluate whether social enjoyment or health benefits are the stronger reason young people exercise.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבחור עמדה או להציג איזון, להשתמש בלפחות שתי ראיות מן הכתבה ולהסביר כיצד הן תומכות במסקנה.
expected_points: Health evidence may include stronger bodies, improved mood, lower cardiovascular risk and bone protection.
Social evidence may include hybrid training, running clubs, parkrun and the attraction of enjoyable group activities.
A strong response should acknowledge that both motives can reinforce each other.
